tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga bzhugs so//

༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi sgo nas las bsgrub pa'i tshul bshad par bya ste/ thog mar bum pa/ zhi la dngul dang rgyas la gser// dbang la zangs te drag po lcags// yang na kham pa'am shing yang rung*// las mthun kha dog can du bya// las mthun ras kyis mgul pa dkri// dge ba'i shing ngam gdug pa can// las dang mthun pas kha brgyan te// su ru bha ti tsan dan dkar// dmar dang 'bru sman rin chen lnga/ rgyun 'bab chus bkang las gsum la'o// drag po a kar nag po dang*// gu gul rgyun bral chu yis bkang*// rang lha'i bsam gtan ldan pa yis// bum par las mthun lha bskyed de// ye shes mchod pa gnyis med bstim// slar yang mchod bstod mnyes par bya// sngags bzlas zhi la dkar ba yi// 'od zer bsil ba rnam par spro// rgyas la btso ma'i gser 'od dang*// dbang la pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /drag po la 'od kha dog nag /dri nga gdung ba bskyed pa yis// gang reg nad dang gdon sdig zhi// tshe dang stobs 'phel longs spyod rgyas// dbang du byed dang tshar gcod par// bsgom dang bzlas pa shān+tiṃ dang*// puṣ+ṭiṃ wa shaṃ mā ra ya// spel ba gang 'dod las sgrub byed// ji srid mngon par 'dod pa yis// bzlas pa rdzogs mthar lha 'od zhu// sngags kyi chu yis gang bkrus pa// de la zhi sogs 'dod 'bras ster zhes dang*/ in+d+ra bi sho dha ya// sngags mthar sbyar ba bzlas pa'i chus// legs bkrus dbang po rnam par sbyong*// zhes dang*/ sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/ mthar sbyar sngags bzlas lag bkrus pas// lha rnams bdun gyi nye bar gnas// zhes dang*/ mi bzad gdon gyis nyen pa la// sngags kyi chu yis lus bkrus nas// gu gul yungs nag yi dwags skra// khwa yi gshog pa rma bya'i sha /gang gi mgul lam dpung pa la// bdug pas nges par thar bar byed// rmi lam sdig pa'i mtshan ma mthong*// gtsang ma'i gos gyon dris bdugs te// shar du mngon par phyogs pa yis// rig sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i// chu yis khrus byas dge ba dang*// sdig med dpal dang ldan par byed// ces so// khrus kyi sgo nas bzlog pa rnams bshad par bya ste// dang por gza' skar gyis byad du stems pa bzlog pa ni/

bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor dang*/ bum pa'i nang du lha bco lnga bskyed pa tshun 'dra ba la/ bum pa'i nang du/ gza' rnams grwa las nag po che// bum pa rtse gsum thogs pa'o// rgyu skar 'od gzhon bum pa dang*// glog 'phreng thogs bskyed spyan drangs nas// bstim ste mchod pa byas nas ni// rdo rje'i gzungs sngags 'di bsham la// oṃ a sta na gra gra ha he naṃ na gra a sta dha dha rā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ de dang ldan pas bzlas pa yis// nus pa kun tu byas bsam zhing*// bka' yi bden pa bsgrags byas te// mchod nas de dag mkha' la gshegs// bum pas phyi bzhin khrus byas na// de dag las ni thar bar 'gyur// zhes so// gzhan gyi rigs sngags kyis bdag gi rig sngags bcad pas ma grub na de dgrol ba'i cho ga ni/ bdag nyid kyi rig sngags gro ga'am/ shing shun nam ras la/ gur kum maṃ 'gi'u waṃ gis bris te/ 'di'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas 'di'i dkyil 'khor byas te/ phyag na rdo rje'i sku gzugs byas la de'i mdun du bzhag ste/ de la mar khu'am 'o ma blug pa'i bum pa tshul bzhin du cho ga byas pas zhag bdun du nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum khrus byas na rig sngags la sogs pas bcad pa la sogs pa byas pa las thar bar 'gyur ro// de ltar byas nas bsgrubs pas ma grub na/ bdag nyid kyi lha la phur bus btab pa yin pas// de dgrol pa'i cho ga ni sa gtsang ma la lha'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa byas la sngar bzhin du byas pas 'grub bo// de ltar byas kyang ma grub na/ bdag nyid kyi ngag bcing ba la sogs pa byas pa yin pas/ de dgrol bar bya ste/ 'di'i sngon du bsnyen pa/ dkyil 'khor byas la/ phyag na rdo rje'i sku gzugs kyi mdun du bdag nyid la khrus 'di byas pas/ bdag nyid kyi ngag bcings pa la sogs pa las grol bar 'gyur ro// gzhan gyi rig sngags bcad pa sogs byas pa la de ltar byas nas bsgrubs pas 'grub par 'gyur ro// nad dang bar chad mang du byung ba'am// 'byung po'am log 'dren gyis zin pa'am/

rig pa mchog las gsungs pa'i gdon rnams kyis gtses pa'am/ byad du stems pa la sogs pa bzlog pa'i khrus kyi cho ga rgyas par bshad par bya ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring dang lha rnams kyi sngags bzla zhing yungs kar gyis brab pas mtshams bcad/ bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bskyed la gnas lngar rdo rje gtugs la byin gyis brlab/ gu gul gyis bdug bum pa spyi bor bkod de/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam 'joms dri ma sel mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /ston pa bzhugs pa rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang gi bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /skyob pa gang gis byams pa yis// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /gang zhig 'khor bar 'khor ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa ste// khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bslu ba mi mnga' la// gsung gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa ste/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /dpa' bo chen po gar skyes par// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa ste/ khyed la bde legs mdzad pa shog /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pas rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' byed// khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /byang chub snying por gang zhig gis// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnam gsung ba// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung ste// khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog

/yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin bcas pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kyi ni bsam pa yis/ khyed kyi don 'dod gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub bar shog /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs gyur// phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs gyur// nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la'ang bde legs shog /khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur// khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces bkra shis 'don zhing bum pa thams cad kyis lha'i bum par bsams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// bdud rtsi thabs sbyor la phyag 'tshal lo// de thams cad kyi mthu dang byin gyis brlabs kyis// che ge mo 'di zhes bya ba'i/ sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ sarba bigh+nān/ sarba ro ga na/ sarba du ṣ+ṭāṃ/ sarba dz+wa ra/ sarba u pa dra wa/ sarba gra ha/ sarba a kā la mṛ ta/ sarba duraswab nan/ sarba dumṛ te/ sarba ku sha le bh+yaḥ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ che ge'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ nad thams cad/ rims thams cad/ gdon thams cad/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad/ 'khon thams cad/ grib thams cad/ byad thams cad/ byur thams cad/ skal ba ngan pa thams cad/ ltas ngan pa thams cad/ rmi lam ngan pa thams cad/ rgyal bsen gyi gnod pa thams cad/ mtshan mo nag mo bdud kyi gnod pa thams cad/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad/ ces re re'i mthar shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes brjod spyi bo nas rkang pa'i bar lus thams cad khrus bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha lnga'i sngags lan bdun bzlas pas spyi bor blugs pa dang*/ lan bdun bzlas te snying gar blugs pa dang*/ lan bdun bzlas pas lte bar blugs par bya'o/ /de nas rma bya'i sgros byab cing*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bsngags pa yi/ /go 'phang 'di ni thob bya'i phyir/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma rungs pa'i/ /dgra dang bgegs kyang med par shog /rkun po la sogs med par shog /mu stegs can las rgyal gyur cig /byang chub snying po thob bar du/ /bdud sde bzhi yis mi thub cing*/ /pho nya mngag gzhug pho nya mo/ /bran la sogs pas bsrung bar shog /gcong rong g.yang la sogs pa dang*/ /gdon dang rims nad med par shog /sngar gyi shīn+taṃ ku ru'i mthar a pa nā ya zhes brjod cing*/ /sdig sgrib thams cad sa 'og tu zhugs par bsam mo/ /de nas rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs lan gnyis gsum du ston la khrus lan gsum byas/ slar bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bskyed/ gnas lnga byin gyis brlab/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gdags so// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga rgya gzhung rnams las rnyed pa bzhin/ yul dbus grwa dar lung gi ri khrod du pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /maṅgalaṃ/// /
